name: community-squad
description: Community squad: reddit-agent grows organic presence on Reddit — monitors subreddits, drafts value comments via the browser, warms up a single purchased account, and reports account health.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Scan target subreddits, score threads, and draft up to 3 value-adding comments for the day.
workflows.outcome: Up to 3 scored comment drafts filed to wiki and surfaced as a batch on the board for sign-off.

workflows.summary: Monitor Reddit for brand and competitor keyword mentions and flag high-value threads.
workflows.outcome: Keyword/competitor mention hits filed and any high-value threads flagged on the board.

workflows.summary: Run the weekly karma + shadowban health check on the Reddit account.
workflows.outcome: Karma trend + shadowban status filed; a banned/suspended/shadowbanned account flagged explicitly on the board.

workflows.summary: Publish approved comment drafts to Reddit via the browser on old.reddit.com.

inputs.draft_ids: ids of the approved drafts to post

workflows.outcome: Approved comments posted from the dedicated account; permalinks filed back on the ticket.

required_vault_secrets.label: Reddit account JSON — single {username, password} object from REDAccs (do NOT use your personal account)
Target subreddits (comma-separated, no r/ prefix, e.g. Entrepreneurs,startups)
Top 5 keywords for Reddit keyword monitoring (comma-separated)
